study_identification_part.si_4_title: Lifespan Normative Models of White Matter Fractional Anisotropy: Applications to Early Psychosis

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Normative model built from HCP Baby, HCP Development, HCP Young Adult, HCP Aging, and UK Biobank; applied to HCP-EP clinical dataset.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "First, we assembled high-quality multi-shell diffusion data from five cohorts ... namely Human Connectome Project (HCP) Baby [20], HCP Development [21], HCP Young Adult [22], HCP Aging [23] datasets, and UK Biobank [24]."; "Next, we applied the model to the Human Connectome Project Early Psychosis (HCP-EP) dataset"
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: Cirstian2024.pdf.md: Results / Normative modelling; Cirstian2024.pdf.md: Materials and Methods / Data acquisition and processing

answer.HCP-EP: clinical application dataset for early psychosis deviation and symptom mapping

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Normative dataset split into training and test sets (12,457 each); model fit on training set; HCP-EP used for clinical application.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "Total N=24,915, (N=12,457 for training and N=12,457 for test, stratified for sex, self-reported race, dataset and site)."; "A normative model was then fit to the training set for each white matter tract."; "Next, we applied the model to the Human Connectome Project Early Psychosis (HCP-EP) dataset"
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Cirstian2024.pdf.md: Results / Normative modelling; Cirstian2024.pdf.md: Materials and Methods / Normative modelling
